notes: walter-exit-mac is an ssh SOCKS tunnel to the owner's Mac. The Mac sleeps or leaves the network regularly: that is normal and never worth telling. The watchdog already reports it as info.
When the owner's machine is not on its tunnel, the local exit fails closed by design (exit-local:closed, info) and the WireGuard fallback exit takes over: not a problem.
An egress violation (traffic leaving through a forbidden IP) is critical and level G3: never act, always needs_owner.
camoufox-max and cloakbrowser-max are the browser engines; restarting them interrupts a browsing session in progress but is safe.

engine_unresponsive: the engine's service is active but cannot open a blank tab within 30 s. Usually it sits at its cgroup MemoryHigh, throttled and swapping (see memory in the evidence). Restarting that unit is the fix; tell the owner only if it keeps coming back.

restart_unit.describe: restart one of the module's services
